findings.title: Unbounded calendar-gap expansion can freeze the Summary view
findings.what: fillSequentialDays allocates one DaySpendRow for every UTC day between the first and last observations (lines 297-305), and ByDayChart then creates SVG content for every generated day (lines 168-169 and 207-269). A sparse or adversarially old timestamp can therefore turn a small input into thousands or millions of objects and DOM nodes, with no range cap, sampling policy, or budget.
findings.fix: Bound the displayed date range or aggregate/sample gaps beyond a documented maximum before creating rows and SVG elements; preserve the exact covered range in the UI.
findings.acceptance: Render SummaryView with two valid spend dates separated by a very large interval and verify that generated day rows/SVG groups remain below the documented cap, the render completes within the chosen probe budget, and the UI identifies the bounded or aggregated range.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read src/components/SummaryView.tsx:295-305 and src/components/SummaryView.tsx:163-269 at baseline c8b98a29508b5eb7725c75a7e2a41dfa94c1feba. The loop and SVG map are both directly controlled by the uncapped first-to-last date span; memoization does not bound the allocation or DOM size.

findings.title: Abandoned-task detector performs a full task scan per cold session
findings.what: detectAbandoned filters the entire tasks array inside its loop over every cold session (lines 122-127), producing O(cold sessions × tasks) work whenever task data changes. With many sessions, this becomes quadratic even though tasks can be grouped by session in one pass.
findings.fix: Build a map of open tasks keyed by sessionId once, then look up each cold summary's tasks from that map.
findings.acceptance: Add a detector-level performance test or probe using increasing numbers of distinct cold sessions and tasks; verify task visits grow linearly and detector output remains identical for open counts, subjects, ordering, and daysSinceActive.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read src/components/TaskHealthPf.tsx:118-140 and its use at src/components/TaskHealthPf.tsx:361-365 at baseline c8b98a29508b5eb7725c75a7e2a41dfa94c1feba. Each cold summary unconditionally invokes tasks.filter, so the repeated full scans are reproducible and survive the component-level useMemo whenever the tasks input changes.
